description: Signed mixed-mode ClaimRequirement vectors for presence-only matching, CVR replay, and the control/tier boundary.

vectors.name: required-presence-key-with-issued-at
vectors.note: PCR-2 accepts a present controlled key without verifiedBy; issuedAt is informational

vectors.name: required-presence-key-without-issued-at
vectors.note: PCR-2 does not require issuedAt in presence mode

vectors.name: required-presence-missing
vectors.note: A missing presence-only claim is a conclusive non-match

vectors.name: required-presence-expired
vectors.note: PCR-2 retains the presenter expiry boundary

vectors.name: future-issued-at-is-informational
vectors.note: Presence does not reinterpret issuedAt as authority evidence or a freshness gate

vectors.name: optional-failing-verification-does-not-defeat-presence
vectors.note: PCR-3 does not resolve or promote an optional failing result for presence

vectors.name: optional-stale-verification-does-not-defeat-presence
vectors.note: PCR-3 skips verification freshness for a presence-only decision

vectors.name: optional-unavailable-verification-does-not-defeat-presence
vectors.note: A well-shaped but unavailable optional result is not fetched for presence

vectors.name: malformed-optional-verification-reference
vectors.note: PCR-3 preserves the VerifyResultRef wire-shape boundary

vectors.name: presence-max-age-is-invalid
vectors.note: PCR-1 rejects maxAge where no authority window exists

vectors.name: presence-recipe-version-is-invalid
vectors.note: PCR-1 rejects recipeVersion rather than manufacturing a result

vectors.name: presence-parameters-match
vectors.note: PCR-2 applies authenticated scheme parameters in presence mode

vectors.name: presence-parameters-mismatch
vectors.note: Parameter mismatch is a non-match, not a verification attempt

vectors.name: oneof-presence-alternative-passes
vectors.note: A presence-only member can satisfy its oneOf group

vectors.name: oneof-presence-group-unsatisfied
vectors.note: A oneOf group with no present alternative fails

vectors.name: mixed-required-presence-and-verified-pass
vectors.note: PCR-6 composes direct bundle presence with ordinary VerifyResult evidence

vectors.name: mixed-required-verified-failure-dominates
vectors.note: A presence pass cannot rescue a failing verification-required member

vectors.name: mixed-oneof-presence-beats-verified-failure
vectors.note: OR semantics permit the presence alternative while retaining the failed result

vectors.name: verified-member-cannot-use-bare-presence
vectors.note: PCR-4 requires a passing fresh result; a present claim is insufficient

vectors.name: synthetic-presence-verify-result-rejected
vectors.note: PCR-6 rejects a CVR result reference attributable only to presence

vectors.name: bundle-hash-substitution-rejected
vectors.note: Strict replay binds presence to the exact bundleHash

vectors.name: requirement-hash-substitution-rejected
vectors.note: Strict replay binds the exact requirement including its evaluation mode

vectors.name: invalid-bundle-presentation-rejected
vectors.note: Presence is authenticated by the bundle presentation

vectors.name: invalid-composite-signature-rejected
vectors.note: PCR-6 does not weaken the signed composite-record boundary

vectors.name: exact-bundle-unavailable-is-indeterminate
vectors.note: A standalone CVR cannot prove presence without its exact bundle companion

vectors.name: invalid-composite-still-rejects-without-bundle
vectors.note: Composite authentication precedes the missing-bundle indeterminate branch

vectors.name: presence-key-selector-has-independent-control
vectors.note: PCR-5 permits the exact key selector because its bundle signature proves control

vectors.name: presence-lei-selector-does-not-establish-control
vectors.note: Existence-only LEI presence cannot become controlled presentedBy or reputation identity

vectors.name: stale-optional-key-result-does-not-remove-key-control
vectors.note: The key presentation proves control while the stale result supplies no tier elevation

vectors.name: different-verified-same-scheme-cannot-launder-selector
vectors.note: MA-3/PCR-5 require the exact selected claim when the same scheme is mandatory-verified

vectors.name: signed-overall-decision-mismatch-rejected
vectors.note: A strict consumer recomputes aggregation instead of trusting signed overallDecision
